title: The Number of Passengers in Each Bus I
summary: SQL: each passenger boards the earliest bus whose arrival time is not earlier than the passenger's arrival time; capacity unlimited; return every bus including zero counts.
outputFormat: bus_id and passengers_cnt, ordered by bus_id ascending.
tieRules: Passenger arriving at exactly a bus time boards that bus (the 'no earlier than' wording).
edgeRules: A passenger boards at most once; buses with no boarding return 0.
